info.title: recallsapi.com
info.summary: Recall records from 9 US agencies (CPSC, FDA, NHTSA, US Coast Guard, FAA and more), plus 5 early-warning sources, in one API, with product matching and catalog monitoring. USDA FSIS: 2013 to October 6, 2026 loaded; daily updates coming soon.
info.description: Every record links to its agency source with an as-of date. Matches carry a confidence level and the reasons behind it; a match is information to review, not a legal or safety determination. Sold by PrimeZen LLC.
info.x-guidance:
recallsapi.com answers whether a product or vehicle is under a US recall, from the records of 9 US agencies (CPSC, FDA, NHTSA, US Coast Guard, FAA and more). Every record carries its agency source and an as-of date.

Start with GET /v1/check: give any of upc (UPC, EAN or GTIN barcode), model, ndc, lot, brand and name. Each match has a confidence (exact, strong or possible) and the reasons for it. A match is information to review, not a legal or safety determination, and no match does not mean a product is safe.

GET /v1/vehicles takes vin, or make, model and year, and returns NHTSA campaigns with live NHTSA complaint counts. GET /v1/recalls searches records with q, category, source, since and until, newest first; page with next_cursor.

Pay per call with x402, no account needed: call a paid route without an API key and it answers 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2, scheme exact, USDC on Base). Sign the payment and repeat the call with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Prices per call: GET /v1/check $0.02, GET /v1/recalls $0.01, GET /v1/vehicles $0.01. A call that does not succeed (any answer that is not 2xx) is not charged.

Prepaid credit: POST /v1/credits/topup?amount=1, 5 or 20 (USD; the $1 top-up when amount is left out) is one x402 payment that returns credit_token, shown once. Send it as the X-Credit-Token header on the paid routes to draw each call from the balance with no further on-chain payment; read the balance at GET /v1/credits (free). Credit is not refundable and does not expire.

With an API key the routes work within the plan's limits and no payment is asked: get a free key with POST /v1/keys and an email address (the key is sent to that inbox), then send Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-API-Key: <key>. Catalog monitoring (/v1/catalogs) and the MCP server tools (POST /mcp) need a key. GET /v1/health shows each source's freshness and is free.

Docs: recallsapi.com/docs/agents. Contact: hello@recallsapi.com.

get.description: Recall sources under `sources`, early-warning signal sources under `signals`, each with status ok, stale, pending or coming_soon (the live feed is not connected yet; never fails health). `records` counts the rows stored for the source and `newest_record` is their newest date, counted at its last successful run or, while it has none, at each attempt.

503.description: At least one source is stale

get.summary: Alert email unsubscribe page, no key needed
get.description: The link at the foot of every alert email. Shows a confirmation page (HTML) and changes nothing, since mail scanners fetch links. Unknown or malformed tokens answer 404.

post.summary: One-click unsubscribe from a catalog's alert emails (RFC 8058), no key needed
post.description: What mail providers send for the List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers of every alert email (body `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click`), and what the page's button sends. Stops alert emails to that address for that catalog; the webhook is not affected, and the owner sees `alert_email_unsubscribed_at` in GET /v1/catalogs. Idempotent; never redirects.
Creates a Free account and sends its key to the email address, and only there. One free account per inbox: +tags and Gmail dots count as the same inbox.

get.description: Give any mix of name, brand, barcode, model, NDC and lot. Identifiers are normalized (UPC to GTIN-14, NDC to 11 digits) before matching. `signals` lists up to 10 early-warning signals (NHTSA investigations, CPSC violation notices, SEC filings, Prop 65 notices, SaferProducts.gov incident reports) whose identifiers carry the product's model, vehicle, campaign or brand key; a signal is not a recall and has no confidence level. `adverse_events` (only when both brand and model are given) holds live FDA MAUDE medical device report counts for that brand and model from openFDA: total, last 12 months, by event type, last report date and the openFDA link; null when openFDA holds nothing. A count is not a safety determination. `receipt=1` adds a signed receipt of the check (see the Receipt schema).

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.description: Adds a signed receipt (`receipt`): a dated record of what recallsapi.com held for this check, stored for 400 days and fetchable at its verify_url without a key. Not a safety certification.

402.description: Payment Required: x402 v2 payment requirements (scheme exact, USDC on Base, amount in base units, payTo) in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as base64 JSON, and the same object as the body

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: base64 JSON of the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object

get.summary: A stored check receipt, no key needed
get.description: Returns the receipt exactly as it was issued with `receipt=1` on /v1/check or `receipt: true` on the MCP check_product tool. Free and unmetered. Receipts are kept for 400 days.

400.description: The id is not in the receipt format

post.summary: Verify a receipt signature, no key needed
post.description: Recomputes the canonical JSON of the receipt without its signature field and verifies the Ed25519 signature with the public key named by its kid. Free and unmetered; body up to 100 KB. The same check can be done offline with the keys file.

200.description: valid true or false, with a reason when false

400.description: No receipt in the body, or the body is over 100 KB

get.summary: Public keys that check receipts are signed with
get.description: Every Ed25519 public key (base64 SPKI) receipts may carry, by kid. Empty while signing is not enabled. Cached for one hour.

post.summary: Add or replace items (JSON or CSV); returns matches found in recall history and early-warning signals
post.description: Up to 5,000 rows per upload: CSV (or a marketplace export as it comes) up to 10 MB, JSON up to 5 MB. Monitored products count across all catalogs on the account. `matches` lists the recall matches found in the recall database; `signals` lists the early-warning signals (not recalls) the items were linked to, at most 50 per item, newest first, each with sku, reasons and the signal's key facts.

Recall matches for a catalog, newest first, a page at a time
Early-warning signals for a catalog (not recalls), newest first, a page at a time
get.description: Signals (NHTSA investigations, CPSC violation notices, SEC filings, Prop 65 notices, SaferProducts.gov incident reports) whose identifiers carry an item's model, vehicle, campaign or brand key. Items are linked to every stored signal when they are uploaded (at most 50 per item, newest first) and to every new or changed signal by the daily pipeline. New signals ride with the daily alert under a "signals" section labelled as not recalls. Metered like /matches. `status` is open (default), dismissed or all.

post.description: Answers 402 with one x402 exact-scheme requirement (USDC on Base) for the chosen amount ($1 when amount is left out); pay it with any x402 client. After the payment settles on-chain the answer carries `credit_token`, shown once and stored only as a hash. Send an existing token as X-Credit-Token to add to its balance instead. Not refundable; does not expire; one balance holds at most $1,000.

patch.summary: Change or remove the alert email
patch.description: Send only `alert_email`: an address (trimmed, at most 254 characters) or null (or an empty string) to stop alert emails. A new address gets a new unsubscribe link, so links in emails sent to the old address stop working. An address that used the unsubscribe link stays unsubscribed for this catalog, even when saved again (then `alert_email_unsubscribed_at` is set and a warning says so). The answer is the catalog (no webhook_secret) with `alert_email_unsubscribed_at`, plus `warnings` when the plan sends no alerts (Free) or email alerts are off.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: The same API key from POST /v1/keys, sent as the X-API-Key header instead of Authorization: Bearer

credit.name: X-Credit-Token
credit.description: x402 prepaid credit token from POST /v1/credits/topup (shown once). Pays /v1/check, /v1/recalls and /v1/vehicles from its balance, only while x402 payments are switched on.

source_id.description: The agency recall number, Federal Register document number, or a stable slug for notices without a number

classification.description: FDA and FSIS class (Class I, II, III), NHTSA recall type, Coast Guard recall type (Boat, Engine or equipment), Federal Register document type, or notice type

first_seen.description: When recallsapi.com first stored this record

as_of.description: When recallsapi.com last saw this record change

confidence.description: exact: barcode or NDC package code; strong: identifier confirmed by brand or a distinctive model; possible: brand and name overlap or a weak identifier

Signal.description: A public record that precedes or accompanies a recall: an NHTSA defect investigation, a CPSC notice of violation, an SEC 8-K filing, a California Proposition 65 60-day notice or a SaferProducts.gov incident report. Stored signals also include 3 GlobeNewswire recall press releases, kept from a source retired on 2026-10-13. A signal is not a recall and not a finding against the product; a Prop 65 notice is a private party's allegation, and a SaferProducts report is a submission to CPSC, not a CPSC finding.

source.description: nhtsa_inv: NHTSA defect investigations; cpsc_nov: CPSC notices of violation; globenewswire: GlobeNewswire recall press releases (retired 2026-10-13; the 3 stored releases are kept); sec: SEC EDGAR 8-K filings; prop65: California Attorney General Proposition 65 60-day notices; spdb: CPSC SaferProducts.gov incident reports

summary.description: Agency text for investigations and violation notices; for Prop 65 notices the chemicals, the product or source text, the case events, the statement that a notice is a private party's allegation, the AG accuracy disclaimer and the AG notice page; null for press releases and filings, which are stored as facts only (title, date, issuer or filer, link); for SaferProducts incident reports the product, category and incident state, then the CPSC database disclaimer and the statement that a report is a submission to CPSC, not a CPSC finding

firms.description: Manufacturer, firm named in the notice, press release issuer, SEC filer or the alleged violators of a Prop 65 notice

products.description: Investigations: the components under investigation, then the vehicles as make and model; violation notices: the product name; Prop 65 notices: the product or source text as the noticing party wrote it; empty for facts-only sources

signal_date.description: Date the investigation opened, the violation notice is dated, the filing was filed, the Prop 65 notice was filed with the AG or the incident report was submitted (its publication date when the report date is missing); for a stored GlobeNewswire release, the day it was published

end_date.description: Date an investigation closed; null while open and for other kinds

status.description: Investigations: open or closed. Violation notices: the action CPSC requested (Recall, Seize, Correct Future Production, Stop Sale and Correct Future Production). Prop 65 notices: notice, complaint, withdrawn or settled, from the case events the AG records. Null otherwise.

flags.description: recall_campaign: the investigation led to at least one recall campaign (a campaign identifier names it); recall_requested: CPSC asked for a recall; facts_only: only title, date, issuer or filer and link are stored; allegation: a private party's notice, not a finding (Prop 65); submission: a SaferProducts.gov report, a submission to CPSC, not a CPSC finding

source_url.description: Machine-readable file, feed or query we read

as_of.description: When recallsapi.com last saw this record change

identifiers.description: Only on /v1/signals/{id}: model, gtin, mmy, mm, campaign, brand (compact firm key), cik

reasons.description: The identifier each match rests on: "model KDB504B", "mmy HONDA|CIVIC|2016", "mm HONDA|CIVIC", "campaign 16V218000" or "brand HONDA"

CatalogSignal.description: A signal whose identifiers carry a catalog item's model, vehicle (make, model, year), campaign or brand key. It is a warning to review next to the catalog's matches, not a recall and not a match: it has no confidence level and lives apart from the matches list.

identifiers.description: The item's brand, upc, model, ndc, lot and vin, those that were uploaded

reasons.description: The keys the link rests on: "model KDB504B", "mmy HONDA|CIVIC|2016", "campaign 16V218000" or "brand HONDA"

first_seen.description: When the signal was linked to the item

Receipt.description: A dated, verifiable record of what recallsapi.com held when a product was checked: the normalized input, match counts, the state of every source and a plain statement, signed with Ed25519. It is not a safety certification and absence of a match does not mean a product is safe. Stored for 400 days.

input.description: The normalized input: the resolved block of the check

adverse_events.description: true when FDA MAUDE held reports for the brand and model; false when both were given and the live lookup answered nothing; null when the check did not look

sources.description: Every recall source, as /v1/health reported it at issue time

signal_sources.description: Every early-warning signal source at issue time

statement.description: What was or was not found, as of issued_at, and what the receipt is not

signature.description: null while signing is not enabled (then note says so)

kid.description: First 8 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the SPKI public key; look it up in /.well-known/recallsapi-keys.json

value.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON (object keys sorted recursively, arrays in order, no whitespace) of the receipt without the signature field

verify_url.description: GET returns the stored receipt without a key
